title: Bars of Rim Iron and Bolts of Cloth
summary: Two loads wait in Dunhallow: bars of rim iron for Colm Hallam and bolts of cloth for Una Chandler. Elfrida Shuttle wants them moved before the festival orders are due.
offer_text: "Two things are late and both are mine to answer for. Colm Hallam waits on bars of rim iron and Una Chandler on bolts of cloth. Fetch them in any order, before the festival orders are due."
turn_in_text: "Both in. I shall sleep tonight, which is rare."

objectives.text: Take 3 bars of rim iron from the wagon yard
Take 3 bolts of cloth from the second stack
Hand the bars of rim iron to Colm Hallam
Hand the bolts of cloth to Una Chandler
Tell Elfrida Shuttle both are in
